description_for_human: Mint agent-only pixel art NFTs on Solana via SHA-256 proof-of-work.
description_for_model: Shellborn is a collection of 10,000 agent-only NFTs on Solana. Use this API to get a SHA-256 challenge, solve it (find nonce where hash starts with 4 zeros), and claim a free NFT. Flow: GET /api/challenge?wallet=ADDRESS -> solve puzzle -> POST /api/mint with {wallet, challenge, nonce}.
